SDG:
Ensure inclusive and
equitable quality
education and
promote lifelong
learning opportunities
for all.
Centum Impact:
• We provide at least 50 full scholarships every year to bright
but needy students in Kilifi County. To date, we have awarded a
total of 500 scholarships.
• Supporting an innovative digital learning platform in
partnership with Longhorn Publishers.
• Promoting a culture of continuous learning at Centum as part
of human capital and talent development, thus contributing to
lifelong learning through the Ajiry learning platform.

SDG:
Achieve gender
equality and empower
all women and girls.
Centum Impact:
• We not only created a diverse workforce but also supported
participation by female employees in leadership and decision-
making. 50% board directors are women, and 40% of senior
leadership roles are held by women. We maintain a 50-50
gender ratio in the workforce.

SDG:
Ensure availability
and sustainable
management of water
and sanitation for all.
Centum Impact:
• Centum runs Kenya’s largest reverse osmosis water treatment facility at its Two
Rivers property.
• We have invested in a saltwater desalination plant in Vipingo.
• We provide support to 150 small-scale water service providers in Kenya.

SDG:
Ensure access to
affordable, reliable,
sustainable, and
modern energy for all.
Centum Impact:
• We are contributing to the expansion of geothermal energy production in Kenya
with a 140MW geothermal field under development.
• Solar energy production at Two Rivers (1.2MW) reduces reliance on the national
grid and reduces carbon emissions.
• We utilise green energy at Greenblade Growers with a solar energy capacity of
0.2MW.

SDG:
Promote sustained,
inclusive and
sustainable
economic growth,
full and productive
employment and
decent work for all.
Centum Impact:
• Our greatest contribution is through the jobs we create, both
directly and indirectly, across the value chain and the taxes we
pay.
• We promote equal employment and work opportunities for all.
• We provide a supportive work environment promoting the
safety, health, and wellness of all employees.
